t_bone.text_zh:
若你控制战斗链上的一张曾被推进的牌，防御英雄若能够，必须用其控制的一件装备防御此牌。
推进
t_bone.text_en:
If you control a card on the combat chain that was boosted, the defending hero must defend this with an equipment they control if able.
Boost

tag_the_target.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
再动
tag_the_target.text_en:
When this hits a hero, mark them.
Go again

taipanis_dracai_of_judgement.text_zh: 每回合第一次另一位英雄成为将造成致命伤害的来源的目标时，你可以弃一张红色牌。若如此做，为那个来源选择新的目标。
taipanis_dracai_of_judgement.text_en: The first time each turn another hero becomes the target of a source that would deal lethal damage, you may discard a red card. If you do, choose new targets for that source.

take_a_stab.type_zh: 刺客·战士 攻击反应
take_a_stab.text_zh: 目标匕首攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中被标记的英雄时，本回合你可以用它额外攻击一次。”
take_a_stab.text_en: Target dagger attack gets +3{p} and "When this hits a marked hero, you may attack with it an additional time this turn."

take_aim.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张游侠攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
装填
再动
take_aim.text_en:
The next Ranger attack action card you play this turn, gains +3{p}.
Reload
Go again

take_flight.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
take_flight.text_zh:
作为使用起飞的额外费用，你可以为你的英雄的灵魂充能。
若本回合你充能过，起飞获得再动。
take_flight.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Take Flight, you may charge your hero's soul.
If you've charged this turn, Take Flight gains go again.

take_it_on_the_chin.text_zh: 本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中2点伤害。若如此做，创造一个敏捷衍生物。
take_it_on_the_chin.text_en: The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 2 of that damage. If you do, create an Agility token.

take_that.text_zh: 当战斗链关闭时，若此牌没有命中，防御英雄创造一个力量衍生物。
take_that.text_en: When the combat chain closes, if this didn't hit, the defending hero creates a Might token.

take_the_bait.text_zh:
瑞普泰德专精
从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌并将其置于牌库顶。
在一位对手的控制下创造一个诱饵衍生物。
再动
take_the_bait.text_en:
Riptide Specialization
Search your deck for a card, then shuffle and put it on top.
Create a Bait token under an opponent's control.
Go again

take_the_lead.text_zh: 本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中2点伤害。若你以此方式防止伤害，创造一个剑舞衍生物。
take_the_lead.text_en: The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 2 of that damage. If you prevent damage this way, create a Blade Dance token.

take_the_tempo.text_zh: 当掌握节奏命中时，若本战斗链中你命中过3次或更多，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为攻击行动牌，直到你的下一个回合结束你可以使用它。
take_the_tempo.text_en: When Take the Tempo hits, if you've hit 3 or more times this combat chain, banish the top card of your deck. If it's an attack action card, you may play it until the end of your next turn.

take_the_upper_hand.text_zh:
仅当此链环中你已下注时才能使用此牌。
目标攻击获得+3力量。
take_the_upper_hand.text_en:
Play this only if you've wagered this chain link.
Target attack gets +3{p}.

take_up_the_mantle.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。若它正在攻击被标记的英雄，改为它获得+3力量，且你可以放逐你坟场中的一张具有隐匿的攻击行动牌。若如此做，目标成为被放逐的牌的复制品。
take_up_the_mantle.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gets +2{p}. If it's attacking a marked hero, instead it gets +3{p} and you may banish an attack action card with stealth from your graveyard. If you do, the target becomes a copy of the banished card.

tales_of_adventure.text_zh:
约里克专精
每位其他英雄选择并创造一个尚未被选择的衍生物；以太灰翼、大地化身、闪电化身、沉思、加速、符文吟唱、地震涌动、灵魂枷锁、幻质护盾、禅定。
你创造一个铜币、银币和金币。
tales_of_adventure.text_en:
Yorick Specialization
Each other hero chooses and creates a token that hasn't been chosen; Aether Ashwing, Embodiment of Earth, Embodiment of Lightning, Ponder, Quicken, Runechant, Seismic Surge, Soul Shackle, Spectral Shield, Zen State.
You create a Copper, Silver, and Gold.

talishar_the_lost_prince.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源，在塔利沙，失落的王子上放置一个锈蚀指示物：攻击
在你的结束阶段开始时，若塔利沙，失落的王子上有3个或更多锈蚀指示物，摧毁它。
talishar_the_lost_prince.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}, put a rust counter on Talishar, the Lost Prince: Attack
At the beginning of your end phase, if Talishar, the Lost Prince has 3 or more rust counters on it, destroy it.

talisman_of_balance.text_zh:
再动
在你的结束阶段开始时，若你军械库中的牌少于一位对手英雄，摧毁平衡护身符，并将你牌库顶的一张牌放入你控制的一个空军械库区域。
talisman_of_balance.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have less cards in arsenal than an opposing hero, destroy Talisman of Balance and put the top card of your deck into an empty arsenal zone you control.

talisman_of_cremation.text_zh:
再动
当你从你的放逐区使用牌时，摧毁火葬护身符并说出一张牌名。从每位对手英雄的坟场中放逐所有具有所选名称的牌。
talisman_of_cremation.text_en:
Go again
When you play a card from your banished zone, destroy Talisman of Cremation and name a card. Banish all cards with the chosen name from each opposing hero's graveyard.

talisman_of_featherfoot.text_zh:
再动
当反应步骤中你控制的一个攻击从效果中获得恰好+1力量时，摧毁轻足护身符，该攻击获得再动。
talisman_of_featherfoot.text_en:
Go again
When an attack you control gains exactly +1{p} from an effect during the reaction step, destroy Talisman of Featherfoot and the attack gains go again.

talisman_of_recompense.text_zh:
再动
每当你资源一张牌时，若你将获得恰好1点资源，改为摧毁回报护身符并获得3点资源。
talisman_of_recompense.text_en:
Go again
Whenever you pitch a card, if you would gain exactly one {r}, instead destroy Talisman of Recompense and gain {r}{r}{r}.

talisman_of_tithes.text_zh:
再动
若在你的行动阶段期间一位对手将抽1张或更多牌，改为摧毁什一税护身符，该对手抽数量减1的牌。
talisman_of_tithes.text_en:
Go again
If an opponent would draw 1 or more cards during your action phase, instead destroy Talisman of Tithes and they draw that many cards minus 1.

talisman_of_warfare.text_zh:
再动
当你控制的一个来源对一位对手英雄造成恰好2点伤害时，摧毁战争护身符和所有军械库中的所有牌。
talisman_of_warfare.text_en:
Go again
When a source you control deals exactly 2 damage to an opposing hero, destroy Talisman of Warfare and all cards in all arsenals.

talismanic_lens.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁护符镜片：占卜2

talk_a_big_game.text_zh:
选择一个数字。本回合你下一次对英雄造成等于或大于该数量的力量伤害时，创造等量的力量衍生物。
再动
talk_a_big_game.text_en:
Choose a number. The next time you deal that much or more {p} damage to a hero this turn, create that many Might tokens.
Go again

tame_the_beastly_behavior.text_zh:
当此牌攻击憎恶英雄时，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中憎恶英雄时，将其军械库中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
tame_the_beastly_behavior.text_en:
When this attacks a Reviled hero, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Reviled hero, put a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck.

tap_lessons_past.type_zh: 闪电 法师 行动
tap_lessons_past.text_zh:
对任意目标造成4点秘法伤害。
若此牌造成伤害，你可以横置你的英雄。若如此做，将你坟场中的一张瞬间牌置于你的牌库底。
tap_lessons_past.text_en:
Deal 4 arcane damage to any target.
If this deals damage, you may {t} your hero. If you do, put an instant card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.

tarantula_toxin.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。
本回合目标防御具有隐匿的攻击的牌获得-3防御。

target_totalizer.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：本回合每当带有瞄准指示物的箭矢命中时，抽一张牌。再动
target_totalizer.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Whenever an arrow with an aim counter hits this turn, draw a card. Go again

tarpit_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
tarpit_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御具有再动的攻击时，本回合攻击行动牌下一次命中时，效果不触发。
tarpit_trap.text_en: When this defends an attack with go again, the next time an attack action card hits this turn, effects don't trigger.

taylor.text_zh:
你的物品栏中可以包含任意职业或才能的装备。你起始物品栏中的每件装备必须具有不同名称。
在你的回合开始时，你可以放逐你控制的一件装备。若如此做，装备你物品栏中一张相同副类别的牌。
taylor.text_en:
You may have equipment of any class or talent in your inventory. Each equipment in your starting inventory must have a different name.
At the start of your turn, you may banish an equipment you control. If you do, equip a card of the same subtype from your inventory.

tear_asunder.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次守护者攻击获得+1力量、支配，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄弃两张牌。”
再动
tear_asunder.text_en:
Your next Guardian attack this turn gains +1{p}, dominate, and "When this hits a hero, they discard 2 cards."
Go again

tear_down_the_idols.text_zh:
当此牌攻击崇敬英雄时，威吓该英雄。
当此牌命中崇敬英雄时，该英雄弃一张牌。
tear_down_the_idols.text_en:
When this attacks a Revered hero, intimidate them.
When this hits a Revered hero, they discard a card.

tear_limb_from_limb.text_zh:
抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，本回合你使用的下一张蛮将攻击行动牌获得+X力量，X为其基础力量。
再动
tear_limb_from_limb.text_en:
Draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, the next Brute attack action card you play this turn gains +X{p}, where X is its base {p}.
Go again

tear_through_the_portal.text_zh:
选择你放逐区中的一张红色行动牌。它直到回合结束获得再动。
再动
tear_through_the_portal.text_en:
Choose a red action card in your banished zone. It gets go again until end of turn.
Go again

tearing_shuko.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的下一张卧虎获得+2力量。
战痕
tearing_shuko.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: The next Crouching Tiger you play this turn gains +2{p}.
Battleworn

tectonic_crust.type_zh: 大地 守护者 装备·胸部
tectonic_crust.text_zh:
当此牌与一张大地牌一起防御时，创造一个地震涌动衍生物。
淬炼
tectonic_crust.text_en:
When this defends together with an Earth card, create a Seismic Surge token.
Temper

tectonic_instability.text_zh:
每位英雄将军械库中的一张牌置于其牌库底。若如此做，该英雄抽一张牌。
创造与此方式抽牌数量相等的地震涌动衍生物。
再动
tectonic_instability.text_en:
Each hero puts a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw a card.
Create Seismic Surge tokens equal to the number of cards drawn this way.
Go again

tectonic_plating.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：创造一个地震涌动光环衍生物。再动
战痕
tectonic_plating.text_en:
Once per turn Action - {r}: Create a Seismic Surge aura token. Go again
Battleworn

tectonic_rift.text_zh:
创造X个地震涌动衍生物。
再动
tectonic_rift.text_en:
Create X Seismic Surge tokens.
Go again

teeth_of_the_cog.text_zh: 激励——当此牌防御时，你可以摧毁你控制的一个物品。若如此做，创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
teeth_of_the_cog.text_en: Galvanize - When this defends, you may destroy an item you control. If you do, create a Golden Cog token.

teklo_base_arms.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 手臂

teklo_base_chest.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 胸部

teklo_base_head.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 头部

teklo_base_legs.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 腿部

teklo_blaster.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击

teklo_core.text_zh:
达什专精
泰克洛核心进入竞技场时带有2个蒸汽指示物。当泰克洛核心上的蒸汽指示物用完时，摧毁它。
在你的行动阶段开始时，从泰克洛核心上移除一个蒸汽指示物并获得2点资源。
teklo_core.text_en:
Dash Specialization
Teklo Core enters the arena with 2 steam counters on it. When Teklo Core has no steam counters on it, destroy it.
At the beginning of your action phase, remove a steam counter from Teklo Core and gain {r}{r}.

teklo_foundry_heart.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：放逐你牌库顶的2张牌。每有一张以此方式放逐的机械师牌，获得1点资源。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。再动
战痕
teklo_foundry_heart.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Banish the top 2 cards of your deck. Gain {r} for each Mechanologist card banished this way. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn. Go again
Battleworn

teklo_leveler.text_zh:
若你装备了1件或更多进化装备，此牌获得“每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击”；
装备2件或更多，此牌的启动费用减少2点资源；
装备3件或更多，此牌获得再动；
装备4件或更多，此牌获得+1力量。
teklo_leveler.text_en:
If you have 1 or more Evos equipped, this gets "Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack,"

2 or more, this costs {r}{r} less to activate,
3 or more, this gets go again,
4 or more, this gets +1{p}.

teklo_plasma_pistol.text_zh:
行动——从泰克洛等离子手枪上移除一个蒸汽指示物：攻击
行动——支付1点资源：若泰克洛等离子手枪上没有蒸汽指示物，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。再动
teklo_plasma_pistol.text_en:
Action - Remove a steam counter from Teklo Plasma Pistol: Attack
Action - {r}: If there are no steam counters on Teklo Plasma Pistol, put a steam counter on it. Go again

teklo_pounder.text_zh:
此牌进入竞技场时带有3个蒸汽指示物。当其用完时，摧毁它。
每回合一次，当你推进一张攻击行动牌时，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物。若如此做，该攻击获得+2力量。
teklo_pounder.text_en:
This enters the arena with 3 steam counters on it. When this has none, destroy it.
Once per turn, when you boost an attack action card, remove a steam counter from this. If you do, the attack gets +2{p}.

teklo_trebuchet_2000.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你推进的下一次攻击获得+2力量。
推进
teklo_trebuchet_2000.text_en:
When this attacks, the next attack you boost this combat chain gets +2{p}.
Boost

teklonetic_force_field.text_zh: 当此牌防御具有压制的攻击时，此牌获得+2防御。
teklonetic_force_field.text_en: When this defends an attack with overpower, this gets +2{d}.

teklovossen.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合你可以将你的下一张进化牌当作瞬间使用。当你如此做时，抽一张牌。
teklovossen.text_en:
You may play Evos from your banished zone.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: You may play your next Evo this turn as though it were an instant. When you do, draw a card.

teklovossen_esteemed_magnate.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合你可以将你的下一张进化牌当作瞬间使用。当你如此做时，抽一张牌。
teklovossen_esteemed_magnate.text_en:
You may play Evos from your banished zone.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: You may play your next Evo this turn as though it were an instant. When you do, draw a card.

teklovossen_the_mechropotent.type_zh: 暗影 机械师 Demi·英雄 装备·Evo
teklovossen_the_mechropotent.text_zh:
行动——支付3点资源，放逐你灵魂中的2张牌：攻击
每当此牌攻击英雄时，该英雄弃一张牌。
你的机械师攻击行动牌获得再动。
此牌计为装备了4件进化装备。
战痕
teklovossen_the_mechropotent.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}{r}, banish 2 cards from your soul: Attack
Whenever this attacks a hero, they discard a card.
Your Mechanologist attack action cards get go again.
This counts as having 4 Evos equipped.
Battleworn

teklovossens_workshop.text_zh:
占卜X，X为本回合你推进的次数。
展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为费用为2或更低的机械师物品牌，将其放入竞技场。
teklovossens_workshop.text_en:
Opt X, where X is the number of times you have boosted this turn.
Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Mechanologist item card with cost 2 or less, put it into the arena.

tempest_aurora.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张费用为2或更低且具有秘法伤害效果的牌改为造成等量加1的秘法伤害。
再动
tempest_aurora.text_en:
The next card you play this turn with cost 2 or less and an arcane damage effect, instead deals that much arcane damage plus 1.
Go again

tempest_dancers.text_zh:
当此牌离开竞技场时，本回合你可以将你的下一张非攻击行动牌当作瞬间使用。
刃碎
tempest_dancers.text_en:
When this leaves the arena, you may play your next non-attack action card this turn as though it were an instant.
Blade Break

tempest_palm_gustwave.text_zh:
连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量。
若此牌作为链环3或更高使用，此牌获得再动。
tempest_palm_gustwave.text_en:
Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +2{p}.
If this is played at chain link 3 or higher, this gets go again.

tempestuous_kiss.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
tempestuous_kiss.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，该英雄弃一张牌。
tempestuous_kiss.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, they discard a card.

templar_spellbane.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点秘法伤害。若本回合你启动过武器，改为防止接下来的2点。
战痕
templar_spellbane.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 arcane damage that would be dealt to you this turn. If you've activated a weapon this turn, instead prevent the next 2.
Battleworn

temporal_wobble.text_zh: 无效目标费用小于你控制的名称中含有印记的光环永久物数量的非攻击行动牌。其操控者获得1个行动点。
temporal_wobble.text_en: Negate target non-attack action card with cost less than the number of aura permanents you control with Sigil in their name. Its controller gains 1 action point.

tempt_over.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，偷取其控制的一个光环衍生物直到回合结束。
tempt_over.text_en: When this attacks a hero, steal an aura token they control until end of turn.

ten_foot_tall_and_bulletproof.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，在你的下一个结束阶段期间，你的英雄获得-2智力。
ten_foot_tall_and_bulletproof.text_en: When this attacks or defends, your hero gets -2{i} during your next end phase.

tenacity.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，它获得+X力量，X为战斗链上防御牌的数量。
tenacity.text_en: When this attacks, it gets +X{p}, where X is the number of defending cards on the combat chain.

tension_in_the_air.text_zh:
悬念
当此牌离开竞技场时，你本回合的下一次攻击获得+4力量。
tension_in_the_air.text_en:
Suspense
When this leaves the arena, your next attack this turn gets +4{p}.

tentacular_toll.text_zh:
将你坟场中的至多3张盟友牌翻为牌面朝下，然后创造等量的金币衍生物。
再动
tentacular_toll.text_en:
Turn up to 3 ally cards in your graveyard face-down, then create that many Gold tokens.
Go again

terminator_tank.text_zh:
若你装备了1件或更多进化装备，此牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄弃一张牌”；
装备2件或更多，此牌的使用费用减少3点资源；
装备3件或更多，此牌获得压制；
装备4件或更多，此牌获得+3力量。
terminator_tank.text_en:
If you have 1 or more Evos equipped, this gets "When this hits a hero, they discard a card,"

2 or more, this costs {r}{r}{r} less to play,
3 or more, this gets overpower,
4 or more, this gets +3{p}.

terms_of_combat.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+4力量，以及“此链环中每当防御反应被使用或启动时，抽一张牌。”
再动
terms_of_combat.text_en:
Your next weapon attack this turn gets +4{p} and "Whenever a defense reaction is played or activated this chain link, draw a card."
Go again

terra.text_zh:
在每个结束阶段开始时，若你资源区中有一张大地牌，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，创造一个力量衍生物。
大地精华
terra.text_en:
At the beginning of each end phase, if there is an Earth card in your pitch zone, you may pay {r}. If you do, create a Might token.
Essence of Earth

territorial_domain.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若本回合你创造过一张卧虎，此牌获得+3防御。
territorial_domain.text_en: While this is defending, if you've created a Crouching Tiger this turn, this gets +3{d}.

test_of_agility.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者创造一个敏捷衍生物。
test_of_agility.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates an Agility token.

test_of_iron_grip.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。若有胜者，另一位英雄弃一张牌。
test_of_iron_grip.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. If there is a winner, the other hero discards a card.

test_of_might.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者创造一个力量衍生物。
test_of_might.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Might token.

test_of_strength.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者创造一个金币衍生物。
test_of_strength.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Gold token.

test_of_vigor.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者创造一个活力衍生物。
test_of_vigor.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Vigor token.

testament_of_valahai.text_zh:
若你控制三个或更多地震涌动衍生物，此牌获得+2防御。若你控制六个或更多，改为此牌获得+4防御。
守御
testament_of_valahai.text_en:
If you control three or more Seismic Surge tokens, this gets +2{d}. If you control six or more, instead this gets +4{d}.
Guardwell

that_all_you_got.text_zh: 当此牌防御力量为2或更低的攻击时，当战斗链关闭时，抽一张牌。
that_all_you_got.text_en: While this is defending an attack with 2 or less {p}, when the combat chain closes, draw a card.

thaw.text_zh:
当此牌在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以放逐它并选择其一：
摧毁目标霜咬。
摧毁目标冰异常。
解冻竞技场或军械库中的一张目标被冻结的牌。
thaw.text_en:
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may banish it and choose 1:

Destroy target Frostbite.
Destroy target Ice affliction.
Unfreeze target frozen card in the arena or an arsenal.

the_golden_son.text_zh:
维克托专精
作为使用此牌的额外费用，你可以摧毁你控制的一个金币。若如此做，此牌获得+3力量和压制。
当你展示此牌并赢得交锋时，创造一个金币衍生物。
the_golden_son.text_en:
Victor Specialization
As an additional cost to play this, you may destroy a Gold you control. If you do, this gets +3{p} and overpower.
When you win a clash revealing this, create a Gold token.

the_grain_that_tips_the_scale.name_en: The Grain that Tips the Scale
the_grain_that_tips_the_scale.text_zh:
传奇
目标攻击获得+1力量。
若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，超越。
the_grain_that_tips_the_scale.text_en:
Legendary
Target attack gets +1{p}.
If you've played another blue card this turn, transcend.

the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.name_en: The Hand that Pulls the Strings
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——费用0：将此牌翻为正面朝上。仅当此牌在你军械库中牌面朝下时才能启动此异能。
当此牌正面朝上在军械库中时，你每回合第一次具有契约的攻击获得再动。若它正在攻击皇族英雄，它获得+1力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁你控制的一个银币。若你没有，将此牌置于你的牌库底并抽一张牌。
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - 0: Turn this face-up. Activate this only while this is face-down in your arsenal.
While this is face-up in arsenal, your first attack with contract each turn gets go again. If it's attacking a Royal hero, it gets +1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy a Silver you control. If you don't, put this on the bottom of your deck and draw a card.

the_librarian.text_zh:
当图书管理员牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将他翻为正面朝上。
当图书管理员正面朝上在军械库中时，每回合一次，当你创造幻质护盾衍生物时，抽一张牌，并在图书管理员上放置一个课业指示物。然后若其上有3个或更多课业指示物，放逐他，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
the_librarian.text_en:
While The Librarian is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn him face up.
While The Librarian is face up in arsenal, once per turn when you create a Spectral Shield token, draw a card and put a lesson counter on The Librarian. Then if there are 3 or more lesson counters on him, banish him, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

the_librarian_magister_of_history.name_zh: 首席史学官·图书管理员
the_librarian_magister_of_history.text_zh:
你的牌库中可以包含任意职业或才能的名称为典籍的牌。
行动——横置此牌，展示你物品栏中的一张名称为典籍的牌：将其置入你的手牌。另一位目标英雄直到其下一个回合结束获得+1智力。再动
the_librarian_magister_of_history.text_en:
You may have cards with Tome in their name of any class or talent in your deck.
Action - {t}, reveal a card with Tome in its name from your inventory: Put it into your hand. Another target hero gets +1{i} until the end of their next turn. Go again

the_moat_exchange.text_zh: 每位英雄可以将其手牌或军械库中的任意数量牌置于其牌库底，然后为此方式置于牌库底的每张牌抽一张牌。
the_moat_exchange.text_en: Each hero may put any number of cards from their hand or arsenal on the bottom of their deck, then they draw a card for each card they put on the bottom this way.

the_old_switcheroo.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：本回合你下一次将与目标英雄交锋时，改为你展示其牌库顶的一张牌，该英雄展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若你赢得该交锋，该英雄弃一张牌。
the_old_switcheroo.text_en: Instant - Discard this: the next time you would clash with target hero this turn, instead you reveal the top card of their deck and they reveal the top card of your deck. If you win the clash, they discard a card.

the_suspense_is_killing_me.text_zh:
悬念
你每回合的第一次攻击获得+1力量。
the_suspense_is_killing_me.text_en:
Suspense
Your first attack each turn gets +1{p}.

the_weakest_link.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，查看其手牌并选择一张没有基础防御的牌。若如此做，该英雄弃掉它，你抽一张牌。
the_weakest_link.text_en: When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card without base {d}. If you do, they discard it and you draw a card.

themai.text_zh: 在你的回合期间，对手不能使用牌或启动异能。
themai.text_en: Opponents can't play cards or activate abilities during your turn.

themis_archangel_of_judgment.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
当忒弥斯攻击时，你可以放逐你的英雄的灵魂中的一张牌。若如此做，将任意放逐区中的一张牌翻为牌面朝下。
结界4
themis_archangel_of_judgment.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
When Themis attacks, you may banish a card from your hero's soul. If you do, turn a card in any banished zone face-down.
Ward 4

theryon_magister_of_justice.text_zh: 每回合第一次另一位英雄摧毁一张其不控制的牌时，你可以支付2点资源。若如此做，该英雄摧毁其控制的一个非英雄永久物。
theryon_magister_of_justice.text_en: The first time each turn another hero destroys a card they don't control, you may pay {r}{r}. If you do, they destroy a non-hero permanent they control.

thespian_charm.type_zh: 崇敬 守护者 瞬间
thespian_charm.text_zh:
选择任意数量；
- 摧毁一个力量或活力衍生物。
- 观众为你欢呼。
- 将你控制的一个光环永久物移回其拥有者的手牌。
thespian_charm.text_en:
Choose any number;
- Destroy a Might or Vigor token.
- The crowd cheers you.
- Return an aura permanent you control to its owner's hand.

thick_hide_hunter.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，随机弃一张牌。
thick_hide_hunter.text_en: When this attacks or defends, discard a random card.

thievn_varmints.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以从宝藏之岛上移除一个金币指示物。若如此做且你为盗贼，创造一个金币衍生物。
thievn_varmints.text_en: When this attacks, you may remove a gold counter from Treasure Island. If you do and you are a Thief, create a Gold token.

third_eye_of_the_sphinx.type_zh: 幻术师·法师 装备·头部
third_eye_of_the_sphinx.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个沉思衍生物：抽一张牌。
法力虚空1
刃碎
third_eye_of_the_sphinx.text_en:
Instant - {r}, {t}, destroy a Ponder token you control: Draw a card.
Spellvoid 1
Blade Break

this_rounds_on_me.text_zh:
每位英雄抽一张牌。
直到你的下一个回合开始，以你为目标的攻击获得-1力量。
再动
this_rounds_on_me.text_en:
Each hero draws a card.
Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target you have -1{p}.
Go again

thistle_bloom_life.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·大地 瞬间
thistle_bloom_life.text_zh:
凝合
创造X个符文吟唱衍生物，X为本回合你获得的生命总量。
//
获得1点生命。

threadbare_tunic.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁破旧外衣：获得1点资源。仅当你手牌中没有牌时才能启动此异能。
threadbare_tunic.text_en: Instant - Destroy Threadbare Tunic: Gain {r}. Activate this ability only if you have no cards in hand.

three_of_a_kind.text_zh:
抽3张牌。直到回合结束，你只能使用军械库中的牌。
再动
three_of_a_kind.text_en:
Draw 3 cards. Until end of turn, you may only play cards from arsenal.
Go again

three_visits.type_zh: 秘法 幻术师 瞬间·光环
three_visits.text_zh: 结界X，X为本回合你资源过的蓝色牌数量的三倍。
three_visits.text_en: Ward X, where X is three times the number of blue cards you've pitched this turn.

thrive.text_zh:
若本回合攻击将获得力量，改为它获得等量加1的力量。
再动
thrive.text_en:
If an attack would gain {p} this turn, instead it gains that much plus 1.
Go again

throw_caution_to_the_wind.text_zh: 展示你牌库顶的一张牌。本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中X点伤害，X为以此方式展示的牌的资源数值。
throw_caution_to_the_wind.text_en: Reveal the top card of your deck. The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent X of that damage, where X is the pitch value of the card revealed this way.

throw_dagger.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
throw_dagger.text_zh: 你控制的、不在当前链环上的目标匕首对防御英雄造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中，你抽一张牌。摧毁该匕首。
throw_dagger.text_en: Target dagger you control that isn't on the active chain link deals 1 damage to the defending hero. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit and you draw a card. Destroy the dagger.

throw_yourself_at_them.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
throw_yourself_at_them.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以让你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。
再动
throw_yourself_at_them.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger.
Go again

thump.text_zh: 当重击的力量大于其基础力量时，它获得支配，以及“若此牌命中英雄，该英雄弃一张牌。”
thump.text_en: While Thump's {p} is greater than its base {p}, it gains dominate and "If this hits a hero, they discard a card."

thunderous_retort.text_zh:
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。
秘法屏障3
thunderous_retort.text_en:
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then your next attack this turn gets go again.
Arcane Barrier 3

thunk.text_zh: 当你展示此牌并赢得交锋时，创造一个力量衍生物。
thunk.text_en: When you win a clash revealing this, create a Might token.

thwart.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，从攻击牌上移除所有+1力量指示物。
thwart.text_en: When this defends, remove all +1{p} counters from the attacking card.

tiara_of_suspense.type_zh: 崇敬 守护者 装备·头部
tiara_of_suspense.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：在你控制的一个悬念光环上放置一个悬念指示物。仅当本回合你被欢呼过时才能启动此异能。
守御
tiara_of_suspense.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Put a suspense counter on an aura of suspense you control. Activate this only if you've been cheered this turn.
Guardwell

tick_tock_clock.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它并对你造成1点伤害。
当你控制的机械师攻击行动牌命中英雄时，摧毁此牌和竞技场中的至多2个其他物品。然后对其造成X点伤害，X为此方式摧毁的物品数量。
tick_tock_clock.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this and it deals 1 damage to you unless you remove a steam counter from it.
When a Mechanologist attack action card you control hits a hero, destroy this and up to 2 other items in the arena. Then deal X damage to them, where X is the number of items destroyed this way.

ticket_puncher.text_zh:
验票员的防御等于生命比你高的对手英雄数量。
刃碎
ticket_puncher.text_en:
Ticket Puncher's {d} is equal to the number of opposing heroes with greater {h} than you.
Blade Break

tidal_surge.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，此牌获得+2力量。
tidal_surge.text_en: If you've played another blue card this turn, this gets +2{p}.

tide_chakra.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
tide_chakra.text_zh: 目标刺客或秘法攻击行动牌获得+3力量。若本回合你超越过，改为它获得+5力量。
tide_chakra.text_en: Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +3{p}. If you've transcended this turn, instead it gets +5{p}.

tide_flippers.text_zh:
攻击反应——摧毁潮汐蹼：目标基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌获得再动。
秘法屏障1
tide_flippers.text_en:
Attack Reaction - Destroy Tide Flippers: Target attack action card with 2 or less base {p} gains go again.
Arcane Barrier 1

tiger_eye_reflex.text_zh:
伏击
当此牌防御时，在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。在你的下一个回合期间你可以使用它。
tiger_eye_reflex.text_en:
Ambush
When this defends, create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it during your next turn.

tiger_form_incantation.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动
tiger_form_incantation.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张卧虎获得+3力量。
若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
再动
tiger_form_incantation.text_en:
The next Crouching Tiger you play this turn gets +3{p}.
If you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.
Go again

tiger_stripe_shuko.text_zh:
你每回合使用的第二张基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌获得+1力量，以及“此牌将造成的伤害不能被防止。”
刃碎
tiger_stripe_shuko.text_en:
The second attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play each turn has +1{p} and "Damage that would be dealt by this can't be prevented."
Blade Break

tiger_swipe.text_zh: 连击——若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量、再动，以及“当此牌命中时，在你的放逐区中创造X张卧虎，X为你控制的卧虎数量。本回合你可以使用它们。”
tiger_swipe.text_en: Combo - If Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this has +2{p}, go again and "When this hits, create X Crouching Tigers in your banished zone, where X is the number of Crouching Tigers you control. You may play them this turn."

tiger_taming_khakkara.type_zh: 忍者 武器·法杖 （双手）
tiger_taming_khakkara.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张卧虎获得+1力量。
tiger_taming_khakkara.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this attacks, the next Crouching Tiger you play this combat chain gets +1{p}.

tiger_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
tiger_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御且攻击英雄控制3个或更多力量大于其基础的攻击时，本回合该英雄控制的攻击不能获得力量。
tiger_trap.text_en: When this defends and the attacking hero controls 3 or more attacks with {p} greater than their base, attacks they control can't gain {p} this turn.

tighten_the_screws.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次机械师攻击获得+4力量。
你可以重置你控制的一个齿轮。
再动
tighten_the_screws.text_en:
Your next Mechanologist attack this turn gets +4{p}.
You may {u} a cog you control.
Go again

tigrine_reflex.text_zh:
连击——若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
攻击反应——弃掉此牌：目标忍者攻击获得+1力量。在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
tigrine_reflex.text_en:
Combo - If Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +1{p} and go again.
Attack Reaction - Discard this: Target Ninja attack gets +1{p}. Create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.

time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.name_en: Time Flies When You're Having Fun
time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.text_zh:
本回合攻击行动牌下一次命中英雄时，你可以摧毁其控制的一个光环。
若此牌是从军械库使用的，本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.text_en:
The next time an attack action card hits a hero this turn, you may destroy an aura they control.
If this was played from arsenal, the next attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.
Go again

time_skippers.text_zh: 行动——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：获得2个行动点。
time_skippers.text_en: Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Gain 2 action points.

timekeepers_whim.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成5点秘法伤害。
若时计者的兴致是在对手的回合期间使用的，将其置于其拥有者的牌库底。
timekeepers_whim.text_en:
Deal 5 arcane damage to target hero.
If Timekeeper's Whim is played during an opponent's turn, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

timesnap_potion.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：获得2个行动点。
timesnap_potion.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Gain 2 action points.

timidity_point.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击

tip_off.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：标记目标对手英雄。

创造一个金吻朗姆酒衍生物。

再动
tip_the_barkeep.text_en:
Create a Goldkiss Rum token.
You may give a Gold token you control to another hero. If you do, put this on the bottom of its owner's deck.
Go again

横置目标英雄，重置另一个目标英雄。
再动

{t} target hero. {u} another target hero.

titans_fist.text_zh:

如果你的资源区有一张费用为3或更高的牌，泰坦之拳获得+1力量。

Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack
If there is a card with cost 3 or greater in your pitch zone, Titan's Fist has +1{p}.

to_be_continued.text_zh:
悬念
每回合第一次你将受到伤害时，防止其中1点伤害。

Suspense
The first time you would be dealt damage each turn, prevent 1 of that damage.

to_the_point.type_zh: 刺客·战士 攻击反应

to_the_point.text_en: Target dagger attack gets +3{p}. If the defending hero is marked, instead it gets +4{p}.

toby_jugs.text_zh:

Blade Break

tome_of_aeo.text_zh:
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁埃欧之书，然后抽一张牌。
结界1

At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Tome of Aeo then draw a card.
Ward 1

选择2个。你可以重复选择同一模式；
本回合你使用的下一张具有造成秘法伤害效果的牌改为造成等量加1的秘法伤害。
抽一张牌。

抽2张牌。

Draw 2 cards.

抽2张牌。

Draw 2 cards.

tome_of_fyendal.text_zh:
抽2张牌。
若菲恩达尔之书是从军械库使用的，为你手牌中的每张牌获得1点生命。

Draw 2 cards.

tome_of_harvests.text_zh:

抽3张牌。

Draw 3 cards.
Go again

抽一张牌。若你为皇族，改为抽2张牌。

再动

Draw a card. If you are Royal, instead draw 2 cards.

tooth_of_the_dragon.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次龙裔攻击获得+3力量。

If an item you control has been destroyed this turn, this gets overpower.

torrent_of_tempo.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，它获得再动。

touch_of_reality.text_zh: 瞬间——支付X点资源，横置此牌：此牌直到回合结束获得结界X。在结束阶段开始时摧毁此牌。

tough_as_a_rok.type_zh: 崇敬 蛮将 行动·攻击

tough_leather_boots.type_zh: 崇敬 蛮将 装备·腿部

tough_old_wrench.text_en: Galvanize - When this defends, you may destroy an item you control. If you do, create a Golden Cog token.

tough_smashup.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者创造一个坚韧衍生物。你可以将你展示的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。
tough_smashup.text_en: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Toughness token. You may put your revealed card on the bottom of its owner's deck.

toughness.text_zh: 在你的对手的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后本回合你用于防御的下一张行动牌在此链环中获得+1防御。
toughness.text_en: At the start of your opponent's turn, destroy this, then the next action card you defend with this turn gets +1{d} this chain link.

towering_titan.text_zh: 在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁巍峨泰坦，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+10力量。

toxic_tips.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 装备·手臂

The first time a hero is attacked each turn, put a gold counter on this.
Whenever you or an ally you control deals damage to an opposing hero, you remove that many gold counters from this, then create Gold tokens equal to the number of counters removed this way.

tremor_of_anticipation.text_zh:
直到回合结束，若任意英雄将创造1个或更多衍生物，改为其创造数量加1的每种这些衍生物。
创造一个金币衍生物。
tremor_of_anticipation.text_en:
Until end of turn, if any hero would create 1 or more tokens, instead they create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.
Create a Gold token.
